data.query:
MATCH (r:Remitter {rmid:'RM-S2'})-[:SENT]->(t:Transfer)-[:TO]->(a:Account {iban:$ACCT_1}) RETURN r.rmid AS rmid, a.iban AS iban, count(t) AS transfers, min(t.ts) AS first_ts, max(t.ts) AS last_ts, count(DISTINCT toString(t.ts.year) + '-' + toString(t.ts.month)) AS distinct_months, sum(t.amount_pkr) AS total_pkr
LIMIT 200
